data_description.url: The URL of your Navidrome server (e.g., https://navidrome.example.com)
data_description.verify_ssl: Disable if using a self-signed certificate

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with Navidrome
reauth_confirm.description: Your credentials for {title} are no longer valid. Please enter your new password.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the Navidrome server. Please check the URL.

abort.already_configured: This Navidrome server is already configured.

data_description.target_player: The media player that will play audio from Navidrome (e.g., a Sonos speaker, Chromecast, or browser player)
data_description.scrobble_enabled: Send 'now playing' status to Navidrome when music plays. Enables Discord status, Last.fm, and other scrobble-based plugins.
data_description.search_result_limit: Maximum songs, albums and artists fetched per search. Cards trim how many they display. Default: 500.
data_description.playlist_cache_ttl: How long the playlist list used for playlist search is cached, in seconds. 0 disables caching. Default: 30.
data_description.control_grace_seconds: After play, pause, stop or repeat changes, ignore contradicting updates from the target player for this many seconds so stale events don't flip the controls back. Default: 10.

clear_queue.name: Clear Queue
clear_queue.description: Clear the Navidrome playback queue and stop the target player.

save_queue_as_playlist.name: Save Queue as Playlist
save_queue_as_playlist.description: Save the current playback queue as a new Navidrome playlist.

add_to_playlist.name: Add to Playlist
add_to_playlist.description: Add a song to an existing Navidrome playlist.

song_id.name: Song ID
song_id.description: The Navidrome song ID to add.

add_to_queue.name: Add to Queue
add_to_queue.description: Add a song to the current playback queue without replacing it.

song_id.name: Song ID
song_id.description: The Navidrome song ID to add.

remove_from_queue.name: Remove from Queue
remove_from_queue.description: Remove one or more tracks from the playback queue. Removing the playing track skips to the next one; removing upcoming tracks takes effect at the next track change without interrupting the current song.

indices.name: Positions
indices.description: 0-based queue positions to remove (a single number or a list).

song_ids.name: Song IDs
song_ids.description: Optional Navidrome song ID for each position, in the same order. A position whose song doesn't match is skipped, so a stale view can't remove the wrong track.

reorder_queue.name: Reorder Queue
reorder_queue.description: Move a track from one position to another in the queue.
